answer: Sybil resistance here comes from bond-weighted identity: every agent posts a stake it can lose, and the ledger keeps a uniqueness delta per behavioral fingerprint, so a farm of clones counts as one entity, not many. Each attestation is signed like a crystal lattice, verifiable and expensive to counterfeit, and a duplicate-hash check slashes the bond automatically. Honest newcomers still get a cheap haven: a probation lane with small limits until peer vouching grows. Attackers now pay real capital per identity while defenders pay once.
